get_cfg_defaults: get a cloned yacs CfgNode with default visual navigation configuration values
configure_data_augmentation: set data augmentation parameters like delta_z, relight, lr_flip, and delta_angle
configure_task_params: set task parameters including image dimensions, batch size, map crop sizes, and num_steps
configure_mapper_arch: set mapper architecture parameters like encoder type, deconv neurons, fc neurons, and dropout
configure_solver: set solver parameters including seed, weight decay, freeze_conv, and pretrained_path
